Fitted black button shirt with sleeves rolled to forearms, black belt and straight black trousers, polished black shoes. Upright reserved bearing. Premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D romance-game character rendering, finely modeled face, soft matte skin microtexture, detailed hair strands and fabric, broad soft frontal illumination, pure white studio background, no additional people, logos or watermark.
original_prompt:
Precise compositing edit. Image 1 is the FULL BODY EDIT TARGET; Image 2 is the ORIGINAL FACE TO TRANSFER. Replace the face and front hair in Image 1 with the actual face from Image 2, preserving the recognizable individual exactly. Copy Image 2's facial geometry, expression, hairstyle and texture, merely scale that face to fit the target head. Do not interpret, beautify, simplify or stylize the reference face. The current face in Image 1 is incorrect and must be discarded: in particular its eyes, nose, mouth, brow, jaw and smoothed skin must change to Image 2, not blend with it.
Evan Miller, adult man. Image 2 has gray-green eyes, fine ash-blond side swept hair, longer refined angular face, subtle lips, clean shaven, relaxed straight brows and cool neutral expression. Match that exact face; remove angry furrow and anime-like face from Image 1.
Preserve the head height and body/head scale from Image 1. Preserve the entire image below the chin, shoulder width, hands, torso length, waistline, pelvis, lower body width, trouser folds, leg length, feet, stance, lighting, white background and margins. Same exact 1024 x 1536 2:3 canvas. No zoom, no crop, no changed pose, no re-proportioned or compressed body. This is a face compositing task inside a finished full-body image. The intended result looks like Image 1's unchanged body with Image 2's exact recognizable mature face and sharp skin/hair rendering. Natural seamless head/neck join. One full-body single character on white; no panels or text. Do not output a portrait.
